name: Rajasaurus Ambush-Drake
journal_prompt: A colossal feathered abelisaur, its scales veined faint violet with the venom the Asura put in its line. It sleeps coiled over a vine-hung temple arch and has not woken for anyone in living memory.
appearance: A colossal feathered abelisaurid with faint violet veins of Asura venom running through its scales.
